zh:
悉尼大学（The University of Sydney）成立于1850年，是澳大利亚历史最悠久的大学，也是澳大利亚八校联盟核心成员，坐落于澳大利亚新南威尔士州悉尼市。学校拥有超过170年的办学历史，下设10大学部，开设450余门课程，拥有150多个研究中心与网络，是全球领先的研究型大学。
悉尼大学在2026QS世界大学排名中位列全球第26位，同时位列澳大利亚国际学生多样性第1位、全球可持续发展排名第15位。学校在校生超71000人，其中研究生约26000名，在医学、法律、商学、工程、艺术、教育等领域均有卓越表现，培养了7位诺贝尔奖得主、2位澳大利亚总理，全球校友超445000人，在各领域产生了深远的全球影响力。
en: The University of Sydney is Australia's oldest university, founded in 1850, and a core member of the Group of Eight, located in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. With over 170 years of academic history, the University comprises 10 study areas, offering more than 450 courses, and hosts over 150 research centres and networks, making it one of the world's leading research universities. Ranked 26th globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings, it is 1st in Australia for international student diversity and 15th globally for sustainability. The University has over 71,000 enrolled students, including 26,000 graduate students, and a global alumni network of over 445,000 people. It has produced 7 Nobel Prize winners and 2 Australian prime ministers.
